The '''Alderaan Historical Exhibit''' was an exhibit related to the<ref name="Mission" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the exhibit was on loan to<ref name="Mission" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] planet<ref name="TEA" /> [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="Mission" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Rich History" was released with ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'', it must also take place around that year.</ref> the [[Kruth Brothers Gang]] sought to acquire fresh access codes to the exhibit.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the warring powers sent a companion to acquire the access codes and sell them to the Kruth Brothers Gang.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderaan Historical Exhibit was mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" />
